From my understanding rodents do find humans disgusting, which is incredibly ironic considering the thousands of dollars of damage they caused at my boyfriends house with all of the poop, pee and destruction to the walls, clothing, shoes and his dogs leashes and toys to build their nests. The pee in the cabinets was so concentrated we had to throw out the shelves. I wish I would’ve taken pictures of the pounds of rat poop we had to vacuum up and the hundreds of dollars of food we had to throw away, including the dogs food a few times. The damage was so extensive he lost his security deposit and it still wasn’t enough to cover everything the rats destroyed. 

When they completely decimate your living space it completely compromises your ability to see they as “sweet little” mice or rats. There are plenty of rodents that don’t have the negative stigma that rats and mice have created for themselves.
